scenes.label: Meet the team
scenes.title: The discovery club
scenes.caption: The discovery trail has a start, stamp station and finish on a paper grid. Meera breaks the challenge into reading the map, choosing a route and checking the stamp. Kabir adds the rule that blocked squares must never be entered.

scenes.label: The problem
scenes.title: A problem to solve
scenes.caption: Reaching the finish is not the only goal: the route must visit the stamp station within the move limit. The team keeps each constraint visible. They trace every move rather than assuming that a route which looks short must satisfy all of the requirements.

scenes.label: How it works
scenes.title: Try the idea
scenes.caption: The teacher moves an obstacle after the first successful test. The team records what changed, edits its route and checks the complete goal again. This final challenge combines earlier skills; the explanation should name the evidence that the finished plan satisfies each stated requirement.

scenes.label: Your decision
scenes.title: Choose and explain
scenes.caption: The written goal requires both the stamp station and the finish within six moves. The tested route did not visit the station. Compare the actions, then inspect the explanation before moving on.

scenes.caption: No. Revise the route to visit the required stamp station and finish within the limit. Success must satisfy the whole goal, not just its easiest part.
